title: Translate a word problem into an equation
microskill_statement: Turn a sentence about a linear relationship into an equation, without necessarily solving it.

items.stem_html: A plumber charges a $45 visit fee plus $30 per hour. After h hours the bill is $165. Which equation represents this situation?

worked_steps.do: The constant fee is $45; the rate is $30 per hour.
worked_steps.why: Separate the one-time part from the hourly part.
The sentence 'the bill is $165' is the equation.

items.source_note: Original repair-pack item. Not copied from question_bank.json.
items.light_hint: Mark the one-time fee and the per-hour rate. Do not solve for h yet.
items.critical_hint: The equation is 30h + 45 = 165 because 30 is the hourly rate and 45 is the visit fee.
items.core_idea: Translate each phrase into a term, then set the total equal to the given amount.
items.common_mistake: Swapping the fee and the hourly rate.

items.stem_html: Lena rents a bike for a $8 lock deposit plus $6 per hour. After t hours she pays $32. Which equation represents this?

worked_steps.do: Deposit 8 is constant; hourly cost is 6t.

items.stem_html: A tank already holds 40 liters. Water is added at 7 liters per minute. After m minutes the tank holds 89 liters. Which equation represents this?

worked_steps.why: Added amount is rate times time.

items.source_note: Original repair-pack item. Not copied from question_bank.json.
items.light_hint: The 40 liters are already there before any minutes pass.
items.critical_hint: Write 7m + 40 = 89 for remaining/total after m minutes.
items.core_idea: Initial amount + rate × time = later amount.

items.stem_html: A taxi charges $3.50 plus $2.25 per mile. Which expression represents the cost, in dollars, of a trip that is n miles long?

worked_steps.do: The asked object is an expression in n, not an equation set equal to a total.

worked_steps.why: Rate times miles plus flag drop.

items.source_note: Original repair-pack item. Not copied from question_bank.json.
items.light_hint: There is no final bill in the stem. Ask whether you need an equation or an expression.
items.critical_hint: Cost = 2.25n + 3.50. Do not set it equal to a number.
items.core_idea: Same translation skill; the asked form changed from equation to expression.
items.unknown_change: Asked quantity changed from an equation equal to a total to an open expression in n.

items.stem_html: A bakery has 90 cookies. It sells them at a constant rate of 6 cookies per minute. Which equation gives the number of cookies left, C, after t minutes?

worked_steps.why: The unknown is remaining cookies as a function of t.

items.source_note: Original repair-pack item. Not copied from question_bank.json.
items.light_hint: The sentence asks for cookies left, not cookies sold.
items.core_idea: Translation into a remaining-quantity function, still word-to-equation.
items.unknown_change: Asked form changed to a remaining function C(t) rather than a one-time total bill.
